external_entities.name: Supplier
external_entities.description: Suppliers upload compliance paperwork and sign in to the portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

external_entities.name: Category manager
external_entities.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it from the corporate network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: Vendor
external_entities.description: The vendor hosts the SaaS portal and pushes supplier data extracts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

processes.name: Portal
processes.description: SaaS supplier document portal through which suppliers upload paperwork and category managers review it.

processes.name: Supplier master service
processes.description: Service that loads the nightly supplier data extract and writes records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: Vendor platform
data_stores.description: Vendor-hosted platform where supplier compliance documents remain.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: Landing bucket
data_stores.description: Landing bucket in the organisation's cloud account receiving the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.

data_stores.name: Supplier database
data_stores.description: Database in the organisation's cloud account containing supplier records written by the supplier master service.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

data_flows.name: upload compliance paperwork
data_flows.description: Supplier uploads compliance paperwork and contact details to the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal — insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff.
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for supplier staff

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Supplier signs in to the portal using vendor-issued credentials.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers sign in with a username and password that the vendor issues to them.

data_flows.name: review and approve
data_flows.description: Category manager reviews uploaded paperwork and approves or rejects it.
data_flows.source_excerpt: review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded compliance paperwork and approval or rejection

data_flows.name: push supplier extract
data_flows.description: Vendor pushes the nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: System description: "We were told the nightly extract is encrypted end to end." System description: "The runbook for the landing bucket says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is." These are conflicting positive claims about the extract's protection; encryption_in_transit remains unknown.

data_flows.name: load extract
data_flows.description: Supplier master service loads the nightly extract from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file

data_flows.name: write records
data_flows.description: Supplier master service writes extracted records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database

assumptions.assumption: Supplier data is confidential because it includes contact details and commercially relevant compliance paperwork.
assumptions.basis: The supplier presents compliance paperwork and contact details for staff.

assumptions.assumption: The category manager handles confidential supplier data because the manager reviews compliance paperwork and contact details.
assumptions.basis: The category manager reviews uploaded supplier paperwork.

assumptions.assumption: The vendor carries confidential supplier data because it hosts the supplier documents and pushes supplier extracts.
assumptions.basis: The vendor hosts the platform containing supplier documents and pushes supplier data extracts.

assumptions.assumption: The portal handles confidential data because it receives supplier compliance paperwork and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: Suppliers upload compliance paperwork and contact details through the portal.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier master service handles confidential data because it loads supplier extracts and writes supplier records.
assumptions.basis: The service loads supplier data extracts and writes supplier records.

assumptions.assumption: The vendor platform contains confidential data because supplier documents remain there.
assumptions.basis: The store contains compliance paperwork and supplier staff contact details.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket contains confidential data because it receives supplier data extracts.
assumptions.basis: The landing bucket receives a supplier data extract.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier database contains confidential data because it stores supplier records.
assumptions.basis: The supplier master service writes supplier records into the database.

assumptions.assumption: The compliance-paperwork flow carries confidential data because it carries staff contact details and compliance paperwork.
assumptions.basis: The flow carries insurance certificates, food safety audits, and staff contact details.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier sign-in flow carries confidential data because it carries a username and password.
assumptions.basis: The flow carries vendor-issued usernames and passwords.

assumptions.assumption: The review-and-approve flow carries confidential data because it carries supplier paperwork and decisions about it.
assumptions.basis: The flow carries uploaded compliance paperwork and approval or rejection.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier extract flow carries confidential data because it carries supplier data.
assumptions.basis: The flow carries the nightly supplier data extract.

assumptions.assumption: The load-extract flow carries confidential data because it carries the supplier data extract.
assumptions.basis: The service loads the supplier data extract.

assumptions.assumption: The write-records flow carries confidential data because it carries supplier records.
assumptions.basis: The service writes supplier records into the database.
